scope.included: Known standard Final Fantasy XI beneficial statuses that monsters, bosses, avatars, pets, or job-style enemies can give to themselves or another enemy and that are normally removable or conditionally removable by player-accessible dispel-type tools.
scope.not_guaranteed: Boss-only auras, encounter-locked shields, scripted immunity states, regional effects, food/geomancy-like effects, and custom statuses can ignore normal Dispel/Finale rules. Entries marked strong_or_aura_steal are not guaranteed removable by ordinary Dispel/Magic Finale.
scope.buff_id_source: Windower Resources generated buffs.lua status IDs; duplicate IDs are included where the public resource has duplicate/variant statuses.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Dispel
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: Removes one beneficial magic effect from an enemy; subject to resist/immunity and basic-vs-strong Dispel limitations.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Magic Finale
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: Removes one beneficial magic effect from an enemy; light-based Finale effect.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Dark Shot
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: Dark-based Dispel effect; consumes Dark Card.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Lunar Roar
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: AoE Dispel-like removal; commonly removes two beneficial effects, with special Fenrir Prime behavior noted in public references.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Voracious Trunk
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: Steals one beneficial status effect from target when it lands.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Osmosis
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: Steals/absorbs a beneficial status effect when applicable.

standard_enemy_buff_removal.name: Aura Steal / Steal
standard_enemy_buff_removal.notes: Merited Aura Steal adds a Dispel effect to Steal and may absorb the removed buff; can work on some effects otherwise immune to normal Dispel, but is conditional and resistible.

strong_or_conditional_removal.name: Aura Steal / Steal
strong_or_conditional_removal.notes: Merited Aura Steal adds a Dispel effect to Steal and may absorb the removed buff; can work on some effects otherwise immune to normal Dispel, but is conditional and resistible.

strong_or_conditional_removal.name: Strong Dispel
strong_or_conditional_removal.notes: Not a specific common player spell name; included for status classification because some effects require strong-dispel rules rather than basic Dispel/Finale rules.

known_nonstandard_caveats.note: Some monster versions, such as Ahriman Magic Barrier in older guides, are explicitly noted as impervious to Dispel/Finale.
Public dispel guides flag some versions as cannot be Dispelled/Finaled.
Public dispel guides flag this version as not dispellable from Zdei.

known_nonstandard_caveats.effect: SP abilities / food / geomancy / regional effects
known_nonstandard_caveats.note: BG Wiki distinguishes basic Dispel from strong Dispel; basic Dispel generally removes magic/basic JA effects, while strong Dispel can remove broader categories such as SP abilities.
